project.name: Large-area tetrahedron: face activation and recurrence
project.subtitle: Exact FL free-hopping control on five/six channels, with four initial tetrahedral spinors and vacuum extras. Twenty controls span K=2..10000 and two phase choices. A fifth channel can take 29.06% of area, while individual areas and local energies recur.
